scenario: [LDET.3.2.7] (text/display plane) — a Float interpolated into a log message renders via the one canonical form ds_fmt_float produces (display == data-text), NOT bare %g. Finite discriminators: a whole Float keeps its ".0" — 42.0 renders "42.0", never "42"; a full-precision irrational renders all 17 shortest-round-trip digits (bare %g's 6 sig-figs would truncate 3.141592653589793 to "3.14159"); and the 0.1+0.2 sum renders its exact shortest form "0.30000000000000004". Non-finite: Inf is a valid Float value (only NaN is rejected, LEXP.4.2) and renders "inf" / "-inf" (the ±Inf text form stated in [LDET.3.2.7]; [LCST.4.5.6] references it). This is the display-plane parallel of the adapter LDET.3.2.7 fixture (JSON data plane, which instead rejects Inf as a hard error). One rule interpolates each Float slot into a log message; the harness pins the rendered strings in assert order.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule show:
    Reading r
->
    log critical "{r.v}"
